name: Effective Depth Peeling
definition: EDP is a realization of PVHVs in Depth Peeling (DP). It reduces the number of completely hidden fragments, captures important fragments early, and reduces warping cost by using PVHVs for on-the-fly fragment culling.
summary: Effective Depth Peeling is a visibility culling technique that reduces redundant fragment processing by implicitly identifying and culling occluded fragments using Potentially Visible Hidden-Volume analysis.
